item.description: The dataplane token validator in kuma-cp performs an unchecked Go type assertion on the JWT kid header. A token whose kid is a JSON number decodes as a float64 and triggers a runtime panic before any signature, claims, or authorization check runs. Th…

item.title: CVE-2026-13341 · 7.4 HIGH 🌩️ — Prompt Injection and Credential Exposure via Untrusted Analytics Data in Kong Konnect MCP
